LLM auditresponse for muster-agent-bin.install:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The provided `.install` script is a standard Arch Linux package maintenance script used to configure permissions on a SUID sandbox binary (`chrome-sandbox`) based on system capabilities. The script checks whether unprivileged user namespaces are available by attempting to run `unshare --user true`. If available, it sets the sandbox binary to mode `0755` (non-SUID), otherwise it sets it to `4755` (SUID root) to enable Chromium's sandbox fallback mechanism.

This behavior is consistent with upstream Chromium packaging practices and is designed to maintain renderer sandboxing security when user namespaces are disabled or unavailable. The operations are limited to adjusting file permissions on a binary already included in the package, under `/opt/muster-agent/`, and do not involve downloading, executing, or exfiltrating data. The use of `unshare`, `chmod`, and conditional logic is appropriate and expected in this context.

No obfuscated code, unauthorized network activity, or suspicious file operations are present. The script only performs local, declarative system configuration aligned with the application's security model.
</details>
